title: Dragon Vein Awakening
next_chapter_hook: At the moment Chen Ji was about to touch the Dragon Vein core, a force wave beyond his comprehension surged from the depths of the temporal rift—it was the will-projection of the Heavenly Eye, manifesting in its complete form for the first time before him.

text.content:
Black mist like an ink dragon piercing the sky tore a ferocious gap above the imperial capital. Chen Ji stood on the ruins at the edge of the forbidden grounds of the imperial capital, gazing at that familiar yet unfamiliar aura, his pupils contracting sharply.

Ye Qing shouldn't appear here—this was the most crucial hidden piece in the chess game he had personally arranged, used to restrain the Holy Sect's influence in the Northern Domain. Her appearance now either meant the plan was exposed, or...

From the depths of the earth, a primordial aura surged forth, as if some ancient beast was awakening. The ground began to tremble, gravel in the ruins tumbling down, as if some existence that had slumbered for ten thousand years was slowly opening its eyes.

A crack opened in the ground beneath Chen Ji's feet, and a strand of golden light leaked from the fissure, carrying a scorching and sacred aura. That was... the Dragon Vein? Beneath the forbidden grounds of the imperial capital, an ancient Dragon Vein was truly sealed!

dialogue.content: (Calculating rapidly in his heart) Ye Qing's appearance now must mean something has changed. The timing of the Dragon Vein Awakening is three days earlier than my estimate—triggered artificially, or... is this heaven's will?

text.content:
He took a deep breath. The Tianji Record Fragment glowed slightly warm in his mental sea. A blurry image flickered through—three hours later, an unprecedented chaotic battle would erupt in the imperial capital's forbidden grounds. Three major sects, the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, even imperial court forces would all be drawn in.

And at the center of that chaotic battle, a temporal rift would tear completely open.

Chen Ji clenched his fist. His Heavenly Fate instantly decreased by 5 points, but the intelligence gained far exceeded this cost. He saw the full picture of this chess game—the Dragon Vein Awakening was not coincidental, but an inevitable event pushed forward by some backstage mastermind.

Who was the master behind that black mist? Ye Qing herself, or someone impersonating her? Either answer meant his arrangement had a fatal flaw.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's black mist suddenly turned, flying directly toward the depths of the imperial capital's forbidden grounds. Chen Ji had to make a choice before it disappeared—

choices.description: Immediately track the black mist and investigate the Demon Path Saintess's true intentions. She was his most important ally and could not be lost.
choices.visible_cost: Consume time, possibly miss the opportunity to compete for the Dragon Vein
choices.visible_reward: Confirm ally's status and fix the intelligence gap
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing is controlled, the tracker will expose their position

text.content:
Chen Ji's figure flashed, turning into an afterimage as he pursued the black mist at full speed. His movement technique was extreme, yet at every turn he accurately predicted the black mist's trajectory—this was his familiarity with Ye Qing's combat style, as well as confidence in his own arrangement.

However, just as he was about to catch up, the black mist dissolved abruptly.

Replacing it was an empty ruined plaza. Ye Qing's figure stood proudly in the plaza's center, black veils floating, yet she wasn't looking at him—she was gazing at the temporal rift slowly tearing open beneath her feet, her expression carrying a kind of fear Chen Ji had never seen before.

"You've come." She spoke, her voice no longer alluring, only exhausted, "I have no time to explain—you must make a choice now."

result_nodes.description: Abandon tracking and seize the Dragon Vein core while all forces have yet to react. The Dragon Vein is the key to changing destiny.
result_nodes.visible_cost: Abandon the opportunity to confirm ally's status
result_nodes.visible_reward: Gain the Dragon Vein's power first and greatly increase strength
result_nodes.risk_hint: If Ye Qing is part of the trap, you will face enemies on both sides

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze turned sharp. He changed direction and darted toward where the Dragon Vein's aura was emanating. It wasn't that he wasn't worried about Ye Qing, but he clearly knew—in this grand game of chess, some pieces could be sacrificed, some could not.

Ye Qing was his ally, but she was also a strong expert capable of standing alone. If she truly encountered trouble she couldn't resolve, she would send him a message through the Demonic Path mist.

There was none now.

That meant she could still hold on.

Passing through three barriers and bypassing two puppet guards, Chen Ji finally arrived at the underground abyss where the Dragon Vein core lay. A massive pillar of golden light shot upward, and a majestic power that could suffocate people spiraled at the light pillar's center.

However, just as he was about to touch the light pillar, an elderly voice exploded in his mind—"

At the moment Chen Ji made his choice, the temporal rift was also undergoing dramatic changes.

Golden rift edges began seeping black mist, as if something was struggling to break free from the other side. That aura was cold, bizarre, carrying a sense of pressure transcending the mortal world.

Chen Ji felt a sharp sting in his spiritual sense. The Tianji Record Fragment quivered frantically in his Mental Sea, as if warning him of something.

At the same time, a voice came from the depths of the temporal rift—ancient, hoarse, yet carrying an unquestionable majesty:

"Chen family descendant... you've finally arrived."

The voice directly pierced through his spiritual barrier and echoed in his mind. Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently—Chen family descendant? This existence imprisoned in the temporal rift actually knew his identity?

dialogue.content: (Suppressing the turbulent waves in his heart, voice calm as usual) Who are you? How do you know my identity?

text.content:
The voice fell silent for a moment, then emitted an ancient laugh: "I've been imprisoned here... for three thousand years. Every bearer of the Tianji Record arrives here when the Dragon Vein awakens. You are the seventh."

Chen Ji said nothing. He was rapidly calculating the credibility of these words. The bearers of the Tianji Record throughout history—he had never seen related records in any classic text. Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned this either.

"I know what you're thinking." The voice continued, "You're wondering why your guardian never told you this."

"Because—" the voice suddenly turned icy cold, "the Tianji Record itself is a chess piece of the Heavenly Eye. And I am its first, and only, bearer who attempted to resist."

Chen Ji felt a chill down his spine.

The Heavenly Eye? That terrifying existence he wouldn't become aware of until Volume Eight—was actually being revealed prematurely?

In the underground abyss, the golden light pillar and black mist were intertwining in a bizarre manner. The Dragon Vein's power and the temporal rift's power entangled each other, forming a massive vortex.

At the vortex's center, a blurry figure was slowly coalescing.

It was an old man's phantom, face withered, eyes hollow, robes already tattered and worn. His aura was terrifyingly weak, but in those hollow eye sockets burned some kind of obsession.

"I have no time left." The old man's phantom's voice became urgent, "The Heavenly Eye has already sensed the Dragon Vein's unusual activity. It will soon send down a projection—you must make a choice before it arrives."

Chen Ji said deeply: What choice?

"The Dragon Vein's power can temporarily shield you from the Heavenly Eye's gaze, giving you a chance to rewrite your destiny." The old man's phantom extended a withered hand, pointing toward the core of the golden light pillar, "But the price is—you must give up a portion of the Tianji Record's power."

"Or in other words—" his voice became meaningful, "give up the guardian who has been guiding you."

dialogue.content: (Eyes suddenly turning ice-cold) You're talking about... Mo Xiansheng?

text.content:
The old man's phantom let out violent coughing, as if maintaining his form was barely possible: "Mo Xiansheng... hmm, that's a name I gave him. His true identity is the soul fragment of the first bearer of the Tianji Record."

"The first bearer?"

"Correct." The old man's voice turned low, "When the Tianji Record chose its first person, that person exhausted his life's efforts trying to escape the Heavenly Eye's control. He failed. His soul was torn into countless fragments, scattered across every page of the Tianji Record."

"Your so-called guardian is merely the largest fragment of him. And the other fragments—" the old man's phantom pointed toward the depths of the temporal rift, "are imprisoned here."

Chen Ji's mind exploded. Mo Xiansheng... was not Chen Xuan's legacy, but an existence older than Chen Xuan? Then where was Chen Xuan's true inheritance?

He felt the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea violently trembling, as if responding to something. At the same time, a familiar elderly voice rang in his mind—

"Young fellow, don't believe him."

dialogue.content: (Voice carrying rare urgency) This person is the third bearer of the Tianji Record. He was sealed by the Heavenly Eye for trying to destroy the Tianji Record. His words are half-truth—my identity as a soul fragment of the first bearer of the Tianji Record is true, but I have never deceived you about anything.

text.content:
Chen Ji did not speak. His divine sense drifted between Mo Xiansheng and the old man's phantom, trying to discern who was telling the truth and who was lying.

However, the old man's phantom only let out a bitter laugh: "Look at you now—you are being controlled by him. Every choice you make, every step of your growth, is within its plan. The Tianji Record is not a gift; it is a chain—and you are the most suitable puppet on that chain."

"Enough." Chen Ji spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm. "You said the Heavenly Eye is about to descend its projection. Then let me ask you—if I accept the Dragon Vein power now, what will happen?"

A glimmer of appreciation flashed in the old man's phantom's eyes: "The Dragon Vein power can temporarily shield you from the Heavenly Eye's perception, buying you three days of freedom. During these three days, you can layout your plans, grow, and grow stronger without interference."

"And after three days?"

"After three days—" The old man's voice turned grim, "The Heavenly Eye will counterattack with ten times the intensity. And by then, no one will be able to help you."

Chen Ji fell silent. Three days. Enough to do many things, and enough for many things to spiral out of control.

And just then, he sensed another familiar aura rapidly approaching—that was Su Qingyao's aura, carrying anxiety and fury.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's aura drew closer, while the old man's phantom and Mo Xiansheng each held to their own arguments. Chen Ji had to make a decision at this moment—

choices.description: Believe the old man's phantom, accept the baptism of Dragon Vein power, and gamble on a three-day window.
choices.visible_cost: Relinquish part of the Tianji Record's power; the relationship with Mo Xiansheng may suffer cracks
choices.visible_reward: Unobserved by the Heavenly Eye for three days, free to layout plans
choices.risk_hint: The counterattack three days later will be even more fierce

text.content:
Chen Ji did not hesitate. He stepped toward the golden pillar of light, reaching out—

The moment his fingertips touched the pillar, a mightiness beyond terrifying surged into his meridians instantly.

That power was ancient, majestic, pure, as if from the very beginning of heaven and earth. Every inch of skin burned, every meridian expanded, every acupoint frantically absorbed this power.

His blood boiled, his bones reshaped, his divine sense skyrocketed.

Meanwhile, he sensed the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea violently trembling—the membrane he had always relied on was growing thinner and thinner. Mo Xiansheng's aura also grew weak, as if something was being stripped from within him.

"Good." The old man's phantom's voice turned relieved. "You made the right choice. Remember—three days, you only have three days."

The moment the Dragon Vein power surged into Chen Ji's body, the entire underground abyss erupted with a thunderous roar.

The golden pillar of light abruptly surged, shooting straight into the clouds. That power broke through layers of rock strata, spreading toward the surface of the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds.

Chen Ji felt something awakening within him—a resonance from deep within his bloodline, as if a slumbering dragon was stirring in the depths of his soul.

"This is..." He looked down at his hands, discovering a faint layer of golden patterns emerging on his skin's surface. Those patterns were ancient and mysterious, like some kind of primordial totem.

"The Chen family... indeed has ties to the Dragon Vein." The old man's phantom's voice grew complicated. "When the Tianji Record chose the Chen family as its inheritor all those years ago, it wasn't because of the Chen family's talent, but because—the Chen family's bloodline is itself part of the Dragon Vein."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He thought of Chen Nian—his sister, missing for many years. If the Chen family's bloodline is connected to the Dragon Vein, then what does it mean that Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect?

dialogue.content: (Voice low) Chen Nian... was taking her by the Holy Sect also for the Dragon Vein?

text.content:
The old man's phantom fell silent for a moment, then slowly nodded: "Heavenly Fate Lock Key... that is your sister's title within the Holy Sect. What the Holy Sect wants is the core of the Dragon Vein—and your sister is the only key capable of opening that seal."

Chen Ji felt a flame of rage burning in his chest. He had always thought Chen Nian was merely taken by the Holy Sect as an ordinary test subject, never expecting her importance to far exceed his imagination.

"Your sister is still alive." The old man's phantom continued. "But her time is running out. The Holy Sect has already begun trying to forcibly open the seal using her bloodline—each attempt consumes her life force."

"If you cannot rescue her within three months, she will die."

Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly. Three months. This timeline was far more urgent than he had anticipated.

And just then, a sharp sword qi came slashing from behind—Su Qingyao's figure shot forward like lightning, the sword's tip aimed directly at his heart!

"Chen Ji! What exactly are you doing!" Her voice carried fury and anxiety. "The entire Imperial City can sense the Dragon Vein's disturbance—the forces of all three major sects have mobilized!"

dialogue.content: (Sheathing her sword, complex gaze) I tracked Ye Qing's black mist here, yet witnessed this scene... the Dragon Vein power is flooding into your body. Do you even understand what that means?

text.content:
Chen Ji turned, meeting Su Qingyao's eyes directly. In her gaze there was anger, worry, incomprehension—but no fear. This woman always stood by his side at the most critical moments, even though she knew nothing of the complete truth.

"I know." His voice was calm. "The Dragon Vein awakens,各方争夺. But if I don't do this, I won't have enough time to rescue Chen Nian."

Su Qingyao's expression shifted slightly. Chen Nian—she had heard Chen Ji mention this name before, his sister, taken by some mysterious force, her whereabouts unknown to this day.

"Your sister..." She hesitated.

"She is being used by the Holy Sect as the key to open the Dragon Vein seal." Chen Ji's voice carried no波动. "Three months. If I don't act soon, she will die."

Su Qingyao fell silent for a moment, then sheathed her sword and stood beside him: "Have you lost your mind? Opposing the Holy Sect alone?"

"Not alone." A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips. "Didn't you come?"

dialogue.content: (Burning gaze) I came, and I never intended to stand by. But now that you've absorbed the Dragon Vein power, you've made yourself a target—do you have any idea how many people are waiting to kill you out there?

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's words held merit. Chen Ji, having absorbed the Dragon Vein power, had indeed become a target, but he had also gained unprecedented power and opportunity. Now he had to decide his next move—

choices.description: Seize the moment when Dragon Vein power is at its peak, directly face the approaching experts from various sects, crushing all opposition with absolute strength.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes massive amounts of Dragon Vein power, may expose all底牌
choices.visible_reward: Shocks the crowd, greatly enhances Reputation
choices.risk_hint: If opponents possess transcendentally strong experts, may suffer a reversal

text.content:
Chen Ji felt the surging Dragon Vein power within him, a cold smile curling his lips: "Let them come."

The moment these words fell, commotion erupted at the entrance of the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds. Dozens of figures came rushing from all directions, each emanating powerful auras—the experts of the three major sects, along with the empire's elite troops.

"It's him! The Dragon Vein power's aura is emanating from him!"

"A废物? Chen Ji? How could he possibly—"

"Doesn't matter who he is, seize it first!"

Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, golden patterns flowing across his skin's surface, Dragon Vein power forming an invisible barrier around him. The first Xuanwu Sect disciple who charged was sent flying by a single palm strike. The second, the third—anyone who came within three zhang of him was pushed back by an enormous force.

"So this is the Dragon Vein power..." Su Qingyao stood at his side, watching this scene, her heart shaken beyond words. This man she had been secretly investigating all along, at this moment displayed strength that completely exceeded her comprehension.

However, as Chen Ji swept aside the crowd of heroes, his divine sense caught another aura—cold, eerie, carrying some kind of pressure that transcended the mortal realm.

That was the aura of the Heavenly Eye.

The old man's phantom's warning echoed in his mind: Three days, you only have three days.

And now, these three days had begun their countdown.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, lifting his eyes toward the sky above the Imperial City. There, a tiny fissure was slowly expanding, as if something was seeping through from another dimension.

"Chen Ji." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying unprecedented gravity. "The Heavenly Eye's projection has touched the edge of this world. I need to tell you something—"

"What?"

"The Dragon Vein power can indeed shield its窥视, but it only works when you have complete control over the Dragon Vein." Mo Xiansheng's voice paused. "And now, you've only absorbed the surface power of the Dragon Vein. The most core part is sealed within your sister."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

"In other words—" Mo Xiansheng's voice lowered. "To completely escape the Heavenly Eye's control, you must rescue your sister. And this is precisely the truth I've always been reluctant to tell you."

dialogue.content: (Inner turmoil) So you've been hiding this from me all along... why didn't you say it sooner?

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then let out a sigh: "Because I knew what choice you would make."

"You would rush to rescue her regardless of the consequences. And the result of doing so would be to completely expose yourself under the Heavenly Eye's vision."

"You're wrong." Chen Ji's voice was ice-cold. "I never act rashly. Rescuing Chen Nian is my bottom line, but that doesn't mean I'll act blindly."

He turned, looking at Su Qingyao: "Qingyao, I need you to do something for me."

Su Qingyao froze slightly—it was the first time Chen Ji had directly called her name, not "Senior Fellow Su," nor "Inner Disciple Senior Fellow."

"What is it?" Her voice unconsciously softened.

"Return to the Tianqing Sect, help me stabilize Ling Yuan." Chen Ji's gaze grew profound. "The old Sect Master has always held reservations against me. Now with the Dragon Vein disturbance, he will surely take action. I need you to hold him off, at least until I return from the Holy Sect."

"You're going to the Holy Sect?" Su Qingyao's eyes widened. "Have you lost your mind? That's the Demonic Path Holy Land—"

"I know." Chen Ji cut her off, a faint smile curling his lips. "But some things must be done by someone."

His gaze passed over Su Qingyao, looking toward the distance. There, Ye Qing's black mist appeared once more—but this time, it wasn't heading toward the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds, but toward the direction of the Holy Sect.

"Ye Qing... so that's how it is." Chen Ji murmured. "She knew about Chen Nian all along. No wonder she appeared here—she was showing me the way."

Above the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds, that temporal fissure finally tore open completely.

A massive eye emerged from the fissure—that eye had no pupil, only endless blackness and suffocating majesty. Its gaze swept across the earth, finally fixing upon Chen Ji.

The Heavenly Eye.

Chen Ji felt a trembling from deep within his soul. That gaze seemed capable of seeing through all his secrets, all his layouts, all his disguises. Before it, he felt like an ant laid bare on a dissection table.

However, just as that eye was about to lock onto him, the Dragon Vein power within him surged violently. Golden patterns flashed frantically across his skin's surface, a gentle yet powerful force surged from the depths of his bloodline, forcibly shielding the Heavenly Eye's窥视.

That eye seemed stunned—it clearly hadn't expected a tiny ant of a person to actually block its probing.

"Interesting." A voice emerged from that eye, ancient, majestic, carrying a hint of playfulness. "Ant, you surprise me."

"But that's all it is."

That eye slowly closed, vanishing into the temporal fissure. But its final words lodged like a thorn in Chen Ji's heart—

"Three days. I give you three days of freedom. In three days, I want you kneeling before me."
